notes: Rule changes the daily eval (daily_eval.py) backtests against the live rules every evening. Each 'change' holds backtest.Backtest arguments that differ from the live rules (at most 2). The evening Claude review may add, retire or replace challengers; it never changes the live rules itself. A challenger that clears every promotion gate for 5 straight evals is proposed to Alex as a pull request.

rules_versions.name: breakeven5_spy2
rules_versions.change: break-even stop from +5%; no new buys unless SPY is 2% above its 50-day average

challengers.name: be3
challengers.why: earlier break-even: round 2 backtest 66% win rate, lower return

challengers.name: trail20
challengers.why: trail 12% once +20%: best Jun-Nov 2026 result in round 2

challengers.name: spy3
challengers.why: stricter market filter: profit factor 2.74, fewer trades

challengers.name: earn_exit15
challengers.why: sell before earnings unless up 15%: fewer gaps through stops

challengers.name: risk40
challengers.why: cap what one stop-out can cost at 0.4% of the account

challengers.name: pullback
challengers.why: short-horizon entry: names within 6% of a rising 50-day average may buy on a 21-day EMA reclaim (live: stretched names lagged closer ones, -4.4% over 10 sessions, t -0.7)

challengers.name: grace5
challengers.why: no 50-day exit in the first 5 sessions, stop and hard loss still apply (live: 10 of 15 post-Oct-6 50-day exits came within 3 days; TXN, ADI, HUM, IQV recovered)
